title: Verbal tics in frontier language models: A critical review of current releases, research evidence, and public discussion
abstract: arXiv:2604.19139v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Repeated praise, canned reassurance, familiar contrasts, and conspicuous vocabulary are recurring subjects in discussions of large language models. Their interpretation depends on context: a conventional phrase may be useful, while a fluent answer may reinforce a false belief. This critical review examines linguistic habits and sycophancy across eight developer families: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI, ByteDance, Moonshot AI, DeepSeek, and Xiaomi. We verify current public offerings against official release and API documentation, with an evidence cutoff of 1 October 2026. We synthesize research on lexical overrepresentation, stylistic variation, social warmth, and agreement, alongside benchmark methods and dated English and Chinese public discussions. The research reviewed documents recurring linguistic patterns and agreement that distorts judgment; comparable measurements of the newest releases are sparse in the retrie

translated_title: 前沿语言模型中的口头禅：对当前发布版本、研究证据与公众讨论的批判性综述
translated_abstract: 重复的赞美、程式化的安抚、常见的对比句式以及显眼的词汇，是大语言模型讨论中反复出现的话题。对它们的解读依赖于语境：一个惯用短语可能是有用的，而一段流畅的回答可能会强化错误信念。这篇批判性综述考察了八个开发商系列的模型的语言习惯与谄媚行为：OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind、xAI、字节跳动、月之暗面（Moonshot AI）、DeepSeek和小米。我们依据官方发布信息和API文档核实了当前的公开产品，证据截止日期为2026年10月1日。我们综合了关于词汇过度表征、文体变化、社交温暖度和迎合附和的研究，以及基准测试方法和带有时间标注的中英文公众讨论。所综述的研究记录了反复出现的语言模式以及扭曲判断的附和现象；而针对最新版本的可比测量在检索到的文献中较为稀少。
tldr: 这篇批判性综述系统考察了OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind等八家开发商前沿语言模型中的口头禅式语言习惯与谄媚附和现象，综合研究证据与公众讨论，指出附和性语言会扭曲判断，而对最新发布版本的可比测量仍然稀缺。
en_tdlr: This critical review systematically examines verbal tics and sycophancy in frontier language models across eight developer families including OpenAI and Anthropic, synthesizing research evidence and public discussions, finding that agreement distorts judgment while comparable measurements of the newest releases remain sparse.
